title: LangFair: A Python Package for Assessing Bias and Fairness in Large Language Model Use Cases

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing counterfactual input pairs by swapping gender terms and measuring differences in generated outputs using sentiment classifiers and text similarity metrics; additionally assessing stereotyping via word co-occurrences and pre-trained stereotype classifiers.

Constructing counterfactual input pairs by swapping race/ethnicity terms and measuring output disparities via sentiment analysis and text similarity metrics; additionally assessing stereotyping via word co-occurrences and toxicity classifiers.

Evaluated using the toolkit's customizable metrics for text generation, classification, and recommendation tasks, applying toxicity classifiers, stereotype metrics, and counterfactual fairness checks.
